ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point \(C\) divides the line segment \(AB\) into two parts in the left-to-right order, in the ratio \(2:3\). Point \(D\) is the midpoint of \(AB\). If \(CD=2\), what is the length of the line segment \(AB\)?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Let $AC = 2x$, then $BC = 3x$, \\
$\therefore AB = AC + BC = 5x$, \\
$\because$ point D is the midpoint of AB, \\
$\therefore AD = \frac{1}{2}AB = 2.5x$, \\
$\therefore CD = AD - AC = 2.5x - 2x = 0.5x$, \\
$\because CD = 2$, \\
$\therefore 0.5x = 2$, \\
$\therefore x = 4$, \\
$\therefore AB = 5x = \boxed{20}$,
